item.title: New White Sox hitting coach looks to put team's offensive struggles in past
item.description: <p>MESA, Ariz. — <b>Derek Shomon</b> sees an exciting <a class="Link" href="https://chicago.suntimes.com/white-sox" >White Sox</a> offense that is balanced with power and contact this year.</p><p>That’d be a welcome improvement from a woeful offense last season that finished near the bottom of many major offensive categories.</p><p>“We have some guys that can slug this year, we have some guys that are willing to play the small game and take advantage of a third baseman being back,” Shomon said.

item.title: Man, 20, shot, wounded in South Shore
item.description: <p>A 20-year-old is in critical condition after he was shot in South Shore on Friday evening. </p><p>The man was on the sidewalk in the 7100 block of South Yates Boulevard at about 5:15 p.m. when he was shot by an unknown offender, police said. The victim sustained multiple gunshot wounds and was taken to University of Chicago Medical Center in critical condition. </p><p>No one is in custody, and Area One Detectives are investigating.</p>

item.title: Justin Oliver's late surge beats Lincoln Park and secures Curie's fourth city championship
item.description: <p>Curie guard Justin Oliver is a nearly perfect representation of his school’s successful basketball program. item.title: Man found dead in vehicle in Streeterville
item.description: <p>A 22-year-old man was found dead after officers responded to a call for service inside a parking garage in Streeterville, police said.</p><p>The man was discovered unresponsive inside a vehicle in the 100 block of East Ohio Street about 4 a.m. Friday. Police said the man had unspecified injuries. The Chicago Fire Department was on the scene to treat the victim, and paramedics pronounced him dead.</p><p>Area Three Detectives are conducting an investigation into his death.<br></p>
